# Game Builder — AI Game Builder

> Describe a game, play it in seconds.

## What is Game Builder?

Game Builder is an AI-powered game builder that generates playable Phaser.js browser games from natural language descriptions. Users describe their game idea in plain text, and a multi-agent AI system plans, generates, validates, and fixes the game code automatically.

## How it works

1. The user describes a game idea (e.g., "a platformer where a blue square jumps on green platforms").
2. A Planner agent creates a structured game design with scenes, mechanics, and assets.
3. A Code Generator agent writes complete Phaser.js game code using arcade physics and drawn graphics.
4. A Validator agent checks the code for correctness and common issues.
5. A Fixer agent corrects any problems found by the validator (up to 3 iterations).
6. The user can iterate on the game by sending chat messages to modify it.

## Tech stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, NextAuth.js
- **Backend**: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Google ADK (Agent Development Kit)
- **AI Model**: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash via multi-agent orchestration
- **Game Engine**: Phaser 3 (loaded from CDN, runs in browser)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL

## Key features

- Text-to-game generation with AI agents
- Real-time streaming of agent progress via SSE
- Iterative game modification through chat
- Automated quality audits (logic, UI, code quality)
- Public game sharing with unique URLs
- Template presets: Platformer, Top-Down, Shooter, Puzzle
